card.name: Just before Asian ancestry mentions
card.fires_on: Words right before the word Asian or Asia in phrases about patient ancestry, such as 'patients of', 'with', 'East-/Southeast', and 'in patients' before 'ancestry'. It marks the point where the next word is expected to be Asian.

modes.label: Linking words before ancestry
modes.description: Small words like 'with', 'of' or 'in' after 'patients' that lead into an ancestry group.
modes.example: IC VARIANT OF THE HLA-B GENE. HLA-B*1502 IS FOUND ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY IN PATIENTS<< WITH>> ANCESTRY ACROSS BROAD

modes.label: Inside East-/Southeast-Asian
modes.description: Parts of the phrase East-/Southeast-Asian just before the word Asian.
